claims.text: Spawns an adapter and runs the agent inside a given GitWorktree.
claims.why: The __init__ takes a GitWorktreeManager and adapter; run_task creates a worktree via worktree_manager and runs the agent via adapter.

observations.what: run_task uses adapter.create_session with 'cwd' set to worktree path, but adapter behavior is not defined here.
No timeout on event loop; if adapter.events never yields SessionEnded, the coroutine hangs indefinitely.

If commit_candidate fails (e.g., raises), candidate.completed stays False but cleanup_worktree is not called because the finally block only cleans up if not completed. However, commit_candidate is only called if has_changes is true, so this is likely safe but relies on has_changes being accurate.
If terminate() raises an exception, the outer finally block will not clean up the worktree because the inner finally is already executing.
